name: Daron L. Wyatt
background: Daron L. Wyatt of Albany County won the 2026 Republican primary for county sheriff and lost the November 2026 general election. Official 2026 general results and the Laramie Reporter's account that voters re-elected the sitting Democratic sheriff show that Aaron Appelhans retained the office. No public-record occupation, education, or military service was found in the official Albany County election results or the other public records reviewed for this Profile.
